q1_issues.issue: "thinks OF everything" is given (Theme (sk_think $y) $y), but the PP names what the activity is directed at, which the instruction set routes to the preposition-named oblique (compare "depend on the pump", "look at the gauge") and explicitly says "is neither Theme nor Patient".

q2_gaps: quantificational pronouns ("everything", "everyone", "nothing") as a quantifier range — no rule says what kind symbol to range over (thing is only sanctioned as the fallback class for pronoun "it") and no rule says whether the (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb> "<word>") companion is due, since "everything" is not a determiner sitting on an NP

prepositional verbs whose PP is a lexical argument ("think of", "look after", "rely on") — the compound-concepts rule covers only verb+PARTICLE phrasal verbs, leaving unstated whether the object is an oblique or a core role

multiword / complex prepositions in an oblique head ("in terms of") — the CamelCase-join rule for multiword surface forms is stated only for inter-clause connectives, while the oblique rule shows single-word prepositions only
notes: The exists-over-universal shape is right: indefinite verbal subject stays a witness constant (sk_woman_1) and the universal becomes the rule range, matching the instruction set's proto-typical exists-forall pattern, with strength 1.0 / confidence 0.9. InTermsOf is left off the unlicensed list as an oblique named after its own (complex) preposition, but the join is not surface-faithful — "are" is dropped and the discontinuous phrase reordered.
